summary: Street-end kerb beside bush, but homes sit 14-19 m across the road.

best_section.where: Western end of Birdvale Street, north kerb beside the bushland

drivers.seclusion: Bush opposite and beyond the west end; nearest dwelling 14 m at 86 m, others 19 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on its kerbs; room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential dead-end street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street; no signs mapped.

flags: Steep: street grades up to 13.6%, about 3.5% at the section
